newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Harmony, Freegold deal to create 2,000 jobs.
newsitem.headline: Harmony, Freegold deal to create 2,000 jobs.

text.p: Anglo American Gold Ltd (Amgold) said on Thursday that a deal selling Free State Consolidated Gold Mines Ltd's (Freegold) Saaiplaas No. 3 shaft to Harmony Gold Mining Co Ltd would create about 2,000 new jobs at the buying firm.
Amgold chief executive Bobby Godsell said the Freegold workers currently at the shaft would move to Saaiplaas No. 5 -- a shaft still with a long life span.
"The employees at Saaiplaas No. 3 are a valued part of Freegold...they will participate in the build up of employment at Saaiplaas No. 5" he said.
A Harmony spokesman said this meant about 2,000 new jobs would be created at Harmony, which would mainly recruit from workers laid off during recent retrenchments.
"There will be just over 2,000 additional people," he said.
The deal also includes the defunct Saaiplaas 1 and 2 shafts, which together with Saaiplaas 3 collectively comprise the original southern portion of the Saaiplaas mine.
Freegold is controlled by Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd.

The acquisition will boost Harmony's annual gold production by 3.5 tonnes and expand its bankable developed ore reserves by more than one million ounces of gold. Harmony currently produces around 24 tonnes of gold a year.
